summary: P0 verification of Ana stored-chart repair (user_id 6a1c17323b39ec46cfd74326) against PRODUCTION (https://mirror-lens-fixes-r-1779710763.emergent.host). 19/20 read-only assertions PASS. HD output via /api/v1/profile/full: type=Manifesting Generator, profile=3/5, personality Sun 21.3, design Sun 38.5, defined_channels=[20-34, 44-26, 28-38] — ALL CORRECT. Jaan was NOT touched (calculated_at remains Feb/Mar 2026). The ONE failure is a real, narrow bug: the repair endpoint did not clear or rewrite the top-level chart.migration_info subdocument, so the cohort scanner (criterion A) still flags Ana because chart.migration_info.resolved_offset is still '+08:00' and chart.migration_info.timezone_iana is still null. The astrology subtree (the authoritative source for the live UI) is correct, but the cohort scan continues to incorrectly report Ana as in-cohort. No 5xx or rate-limiting encountered on admin endpoints. No unrelated charts appear to have been modified.

minor.issue: Repair endpoint at /app/backend/routers/admin_chart_provenance_repair.py lines 402-413 sets {astrology, human_design, updated_at, calculated_at, debug_stamp} but does NOT clear or rewrite the top-level chart.migration_info document. rca_of_issue: RCA for the one remaining failure (Ana still in cohort): The repair endpoint POST /api/admin/repair_chart_for_user successfully recomputed Ana's chart with the correct UTC (1983-05-03T11:05:00) and stamped all V-A markers + debug_stamp on the astrology subtree. However, the cohort scanner GET /api/admin/scan_timezone_fallback_cohort reads chart.migration_info (a TOP-LEVEL chart field), not chart.astrology.metadata. Criterion A specifically checks `chart.migration_info.resolved_offset == '+08:00' AND chart.migration_info.timezone_iana null/empty AND lon outside Asia band`. The repair write block (lines 402-413) only $sets astrology/human_design/updated_at/calculated_at/debug_stamp — it never touches chart.migration_info. So the stale '+08:00' fallback metadata persists from BEFORE the repair, and the scanner keeps reporting Ana as in-cohort even though her chart is mathematically correct. Reproduction: GET /api/admin/scan_timezone_fallback_cohort?confirm=SCAN_TIMEZONE_FALLBACK_COHORT_2026_06_26&limit=500 — Ana appears in 'cohort' array with criteria_hit=['A']. Mitigation: extend the chart_update $set in admin_chart_provenance_repair.py to either $set chart.migration_info={resolved_offset, timezone_iana, migrated_at, source} or $unset migration_info. Severity: LOW for end users (live chart is correct), MEDIUM for operators (cohort scan gives false positive and could cause repeat-repair operator confusion).
